set.body: From m1's owner review of beads 7+8 (post-01M15FZ8VB1V63E38ZA5JD20DQ nit 4): 'We never went back to Montreal' and 'She said anyway we should leave Montreal' currently give ExplicitReturn; only the current digression is consulted ('…Montreal. Another time … Paris. Then we walked around Montreal.' is Unattached, not a resumption of the Montreal digression); ClusterContinuity ignores recall relations so a causally linked unit lands in its own Unattached cluster. Design checkpoint on coordination first (typed guards, not heuristics). After the placement-export bead.
set.title: interview: return-rule extensions — negation/reported-speech guard on ReturnMarker; resumption of an earlier (non-current) digression; ClusterContinuity consults recall relations (causal/temporal edges)
